info.description: Private staff inspection, evidence, author handoff, rejection, and quarantine operations for the local synthetic runtime. Never include this contract in student bundles; authentication and access checks remain runtime-enforced.
info.title: TSA Platform private staff API contracts

post.description: Requires the trusted same-origin staff session, current CSRF cookie/token, and an idempotency key. Origin/session/CSRF validation runs before JSON parsing; command role, revision, and validation checks run after parsing. The strict JSON body is limited to 1 MiB. A successful response is an operation receipt and does not report delivery-hold drain completion.
